svg.title: Local BWT implementation comparison
svg.desc: Exact recorded mean timings from experiments_data.json, as compared in the project slides. 20Ma: Naive 5.48 ms, Skew / lists 7.43 ms, Skew / NumPy 10.59 ms; 20Mb: Naive 2.51 ms, Skew / lists 4.51 ms, Skew / NumPy 7.70 ms. These are calls within one historical profiling run, not repeated benchmark trials. The variants differ in their suffix-array implementation and representation.
